income.title: Income
income.subtitle: Manage your income
income.destinationAccountHint: If an account is linked, the balance increases when you mark income as «Received» (in the table or here).
income.statusSelectHint: «Received» with a destination account updates the balance when saving (new income) or when editing.
income.recurrenceStartHint: First date when the calendar and projections include the series (inclusive).
income.recurrenceEndHint: Last date it applies (inclusive). Leave empty if the series has no defined end.
income.refHintAnnual: Repeats each year on the same calendar date.
income.semiMonthlyBlurb: Two payments per month are considered: day 15 and day 30 (or the last day of the month if shorter).
income.semiMonthlyNarrow: You can bound the series validity with the optional fields below.

variablePeriodPay.title: Amount received this month
variablePeriodPay.hint: Only this collection uses this amount. It does not change other months, future periods, or the reference amount on the record.

profile.title: My profile

profile.passwordSectionHint: Use a strong password you do not reuse elsewhere

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Manage your expenses
expenses.vehicleLinkedHint: It can only be a one-off expense; changes are reflected in Vehicles
expenses.accountImpactHint: One-off or annual: deducts on save. Recurrent (e.g. monthly): deducts when marked as paid this month.
expenses.paymentStatusHint: Paid with source account: for one-off or annual it deducts on save; for monthly it marks payment for this period. Recurrent unpaid items do not adjust balance until paid.
expenses.recurrenceStartHint: First date when calendar and projections include this series (inclusive).
expenses.recurrenceEndHint: Last date it applies (inclusive). Leave empty for no end date.

variablePeriodPay.title: Payment amount for this month
variablePeriodPay.hint: Only this payment uses this amount. It does not change other months, future periods, or the reference amount on the expense.

financialGoals.savingsAccountHint: If you choose an account, each contribution increases that account balance in the goal currency.
financialGoals.contributionSourceHint: If you choose a source, the amount is debited from that account toward the goal account (when the goal has one).
financialGoals.noContributions: No contributions recorded for this goal.

budgets.title: Budgets

accounts.noMovements: No movements have been recorded in this account yet.
accounts.showingRecentMovements: Showing {{shown}} most recent out of {{total}} movements.
accounts.transferDescription: It does not register income or expense: it only moves balance.
accounts.adjustDescription: Fix differences (positive adds, negative subtracts). Usually used for cash after counting.

vehicles.subtitle: Manage your vehicles and their expenses

vehicles.expenseCrossModulePrefix: The expense is saved here and in the

vehicles.noCategoriesHint: No categories — create them under Categories
vehicles.accountDebitHint: Deducts from the account balance in the expense currency.
vehicles.chartAmountsHint: Amounts shown in {{primary}} ({{secondary}} converted at your profile rate).

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.subtitle: Registered accounts, subscription plans, and support actions (impersonate, enable).
adminUsers.filtersHint: Registered filters by signup date. Billing period: current cycle (UTC) overlapping the range; excludes users without a subscription row or period dates.
adminUsers.billingCycleAssignAria: Billing cycle when assigning plan for {{email}}

adminUserDetail.superAdminNoPlan: Full-access user (super admin); no paid plan applies.
adminUserDetail.changePlanHint: Same logic as the admin list. PayPal webhooks may adjust period and billing interval afterward.

projections.title: Projections
projections.subtitle: Future cash-flow estimate from income/expenses in the app and bank account balances
projections.calculationHelp: How it is calculated: monthly average of non-recurring income and expenses from the last 3 months; plus the monthly equivalent of all recurring items (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, etc.). Starting balance includes only bank accounts ({{primary}} and {{secondary}} at your rate). It does not include cards, loans, accounts payable, or receivable.

cashFlow.title: Cash flow
cashFlow.incomeBreakdownHint: One-off by fixed/variable type; recurring shows all frequencies (0 when not applicable). Unified in {{currency}}.
cashFlow.expensesBreakdownHint: One-off and recurring by type; recurring includes all frequencies (0 when no activity in the period).

calendar.title: Financial calendar
calendar.showHistoryPanel: Show archived event history (no active source)
calendar.summaryPendingHint: Future payments in the period (today or later).
calendar.summaryOverdueHint: Overdue status or pending with a past date.
calendar.summaryFootnote: Sum of calendar events in the visible range. Amounts in DOP; USD uses your rate from settings. Pending income and unpaid expenses are excluded from the totals above.
calendar.historyIntro: Archived copies of events no longer shown in the main view because the source income, expense, loan, or card was removed, or archived when deleted. Figures and dates are kept for reference only.
calendar.historyEmpty: No archived events in the visible period.
calendar.periodDetailHint: Row-by-row list of calendar events in the visible range. Respects your filters and the «Show paid/received» option.
calendar.periodDetailEmptyIncome: No income items in the visible period.
calendar.periodDetailEmptyExpense: No expenses or payments in the visible period.
calendar.periodDetailSearchPlaceholder: Search by date, type, title, amount, or status…
calendar.periodDetailNoMatches: No rows match your search or filters.

financialItemHistory.intro: Calendar events linked to this record (paid, received, pending, or overdue), only from the item start (recurrence start, reference date, or creation date) through today. «Archived» means the event no longer appears on the main calendar view.
financialItemHistory.oneOffPaidHint: One-off item already settled: no next date.
financialItemHistory.empty: No calendar events between this record’s start and today.

subscription.title: Plans & subscription
subscription.periodFootnote: Next renewal or cycle end as shown above. Dates sync with PayPal when the subscription is linked.
subscription.superAdminPaypalBody: Payments are processed with PayPal. Set PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID and PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET on the server, and PayPal plan IDs on each row in the admin «Subscription plans» screen.

subscriptionPayments.title: Payment history
subscriptionPayments.subtitle: Payments recorded for your subscription.
subscriptionPayments.superAdminNotice: Customer payment history is viewed from the administration panel.
subscriptionPayments.emptyState: No payments recorded yet. After a charge, it will appear here automatically.

admin.dashboardSubtitle: KPIs and quick links to the console
admin.paymentsLine: Last 30 days: {{count}} charges · {{total}} records in history
admin.paymentsEmpty: No totals in this period (no completed charges or no rows in that window).
admin.paymentsFootnote: Sum of subscription_payments in completed status (e.g. webhook). Does not reflect PayPal fees or taxes.
admin.linkPlansSub: Prices, modules per plan and PayPal integration

adminAudit.title: Audit
adminAudit.subtitle: Actions recorded in the console (super admin)

adminStatus.schedulerMissing: Daily job was not registered (did `startNotificationScheduler` fail on startup?).
adminStatus.title: System status
adminStatus.subtitle: Database, Node process, and minimal signal for operation (no APM)
adminStatus.schedulerIntro: Cron (node-cron) bulk notification sweep (cards, loans, recurring expenses). Status only; does not run work here.
adminStatus.cronInvalid: Cron expression failed validation on the server.
adminStatus.deploySweepNote: After each API deploy a complementary pass also runs (~5 s after startup), in addition to the daily schedule.
adminStatus.dataQualityIntro: Row counts; does not modify the database. “Done” criterion for the plan: reduce unjustified nulls. Optional script:
adminStatus.periodFieldsWarning: Period fields need completion. Review with SQL backfill or new PayPal events.
adminStatus.footerNotApm: Not APM: no queues, per-request CPU, or alerts. Use this to verify the API responds and the process stays within bounded memory.

adminGlobalSettings.title: Global settings
adminGlobalSettings.subtitle: System flags; super administrators only
adminGlobalSettings.registrationHelp: When disabled, the registration endpoint rejects new signups. Existing users can still log in.
adminGlobalSettings.maintenanceHelp: When enabled, non–super-admin users cannot write to the API (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), except authentication, subscription, and administration routes. Super admins retain full access.
adminGlobalSettings.maintenanceActive: Active — click to turn off maintenance
adminGlobalSettings.maintenanceInactive: Inactive — click to enable read-only for users

adminPlans.title: Subscription plans
adminPlans.subtitle: Prices, PayPal plan IDs, and modules per plan
adminPlans.helpLi1: The API requires PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID, PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET, and PAYPAL_API_BASE (sandbox or live).
adminPlans.helpLi2: "Sync PayPal" creates the catalog product and monthly/yearly billing plans from saved prices; it writes the IDs to the database.
adminPlans.helpLi3: You can also paste product and plan IDs manually if they already exist in the PayPal dashboard.
adminPlans.helpLi4: If you change prices, you may need to sync again to align the catalog with the app.
adminPlans.syncPayPalTooltip: Create in PayPal the product and billing plans (monthly/yearly) based on prices
adminPlans.createIntro: Created with price 0 and minimum modules (overview, subscription, profile). Adjust prices, module matrix, and PayPal IDs in Edit.
adminPlans.slugHint: Generated from the name until you edit this field.
adminPlans.paypalFieldPlaceholder: Optional if you use Sync PayPal
